There are some sci-fi movies that don’t just leave the door open for a sequel… they practically kick it off the hinges. Massive worlds were built with gobs of unanswered questions, and endings that feel like the beginning of something much much bigger... yet for "reasons," Hollywood never followed through.

In this video, I’m discussing a list of incredible science fiction films that were set up for dynamite sequels… that never got made. Some were planned and quietly canceled. Others had strong fan demand but were ignored. And a few just feel like unfinished stories that deserve another chapter.

If you’re a fan of smart, high-concept sci-fi, there’s a good chance a few of these will frustrate you.
